text:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — OrbitLabs flagged a big unexpected jump on invoice INV-2026-307, looks like a duplicate dedicated capacity charge. Can someone check?
CostBot: Invoice INV-2026-307 created by billing-service at 2026-03-02T02:12:09Z. Potential duplicate line detected by duplicate-detector:v1.
Liam Nguyen: On it. Please confirm account id and I'll pull the raw usage/alloc events.
Aisha Patel: account_id: acct_ol_93. Quick snapshot from the invoice lines: ```SKU: dedicated_gpu | Qty: 1 | Period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31 | Amount: $12,000
SKU: dedicated_gpu | Qty: 1 | Period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31 | Amount: $12,000 (duplicate)```
Emma Chen: I see two reserve events in the billing ledger for the same provisioning run — provisioning retried and created a second charge line. We can void one charge line and issue a credit memo, but need finance approval for the adjustment.
Riley Ortiz: OrbitLabs is strategic and mid-contract. My recommendation: manual goodwill credit equal to the duplicated line ($12,000) + a 30% promo credit on next invoice to smooth the relationship. Need explicit approval from finance lead to proceed.
Liam Nguyen: From reconciliation side, if we apply a manual credit we should use GL code 4-520 and reference BILL-7345 for audit trail. Also mark the invoice as "adjusted" so downstream reports ignore the duplicate.
Aisha Patel: Agree with Riley's customer-facing approach. Approving a $12k manual credit now and 30% off next invoice as promo. Emma — can you create the credit memo and file the AR ticket?
Emma Chen: Will do. Creating credit memo now — CM-1759 — linking to BILL-7345 and tagging with GL 4-520. Note: we're applying the credit to the account balance (not issuing a cash refund) per OrbitLabs preference.
Riley Ortiz: +1 from Account Mgmt. I'll notify the customer and include the promo code for next invoice.
Liam Nguyen: After CM is posted, I will run reconciliation and update the monthly variance report.
CostBot: CM-1759 posted to billing-db at 2026-03-02T04:03:10Z.
Emma Chen: CM created and AR notified, tracking in Zendesk ticket ZD-9821. Leaving a note to exclude this from Q1 usage-backed metrics.
Aisha Patel: OrbitLabs confirmed via email they accept account credit (no cash refund). Closing the loop — thanks everyone :tada:
Riley Ortiz: I'll follow up with a short account note and the 30% promo details.
Emma Chen: Filing final docs to /billing/credits/2026/CM-1759.pdf and attaching to ZD-9821.
Aisha Patel: Closing thread. If anything else pops up, re-open or ping me directly.
